# k0rdent_network (Data Source)

One network, by name, read rather than managed.

Unlike the resource, this reads a cluster-provisioned network as readily as a tenant one. Those carry a `cluster_id`, cannot be written through the tenant API at all, and are what a module has to find when it needs to place a workload beside a cluster's own subnet.

The fabric-specific values are flattened rather than nested by kind, because a reader is asking what this network resolved to rather than declaring which kind to build. `vlan_id` here is always what the platform allocated.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# One network by name, including networks a cluster made for itself, which
# the resource can't manage.

data "k0rdent_network" "training" {
  id = "training-fabric"
}

# The VLAN the network got, even if it was created with vlan_id = "auto".
output "vlan" {
  value = data.k0rdent_network.training.vlan_id
}

# Warn if a cluster made this network, since then it can't be managed.
check "network_is_ours_to_manage" {
  assert {
    condition     = data.k0rdent_network.training.cluster_id == null
    error_message = "training-fabric was provisioned by cluster ${data.k0rdent_network.training.cluster_id} and cannot be managed through the provider."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The network's name. **Constraints:** Must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen (`[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?`), because it becomes a segment of a request URL.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project to read. Defaults to the provider's `project`. **Constraints:** Must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen (`[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?`), because it becomes a segment of a request URL.
- `region` (String) Region to read. Defaults to the provider's `region`. **Constraints:** Must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen (`[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?`), because it becomes a segment of a request URL.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_id` (String) UID of the cluster that provisioned it. Null on a network a tenant created, set on one the cluster lifecycle owns. A network with this set cannot be managed by the resource.
- `description` (String) Free-form text describing it, for people to read.
- `display_name` (String) Human-friendly name, for display only.
- `mtu` (Number) MTU, on an EVPN network.
- `partition` (String) Partition, on an InfiniBand network.
- `pkey` (String) The partition key the platform allocated, on an InfiniBand network.
- `self_link` (String) Platform-defined reference to this object.
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state as last read from the platform.
- `state_message` (String) The platform's own explanation of the state.
- `tags` (Map of String) User-defined labels, as key-value pairs.
- `type` (String) `evpn`, `infiniband` or `nvlink`. The other attributes depend on it.
- `vlan_id` (String) The VLAN the platform allocated, on an EVPN network. Never `auto`: this is the resolved value, not the request.
- `vpc` (String) The fabric VPC this network attaches to, on a cluster-provisioned network.
